problem: The probability range is printed as "0 i ≤ 1", which is garbled: the variable and the lower-bound inequality sign are missing, so the definition of pi is incomplete and a student cannot tell whether p = 0 is allowed.
fix: Write "with 0 < p<sub>i</sub> ≤ 1 and Σp<sub>i</sub> = 1". (p<sub>i</sub> = 0 is allowed for symbols that never occur; such a symbol contributes 0 to entropy, as stated later.)

problem: "A source with many likely symbols has high entropy" is loose — many likely symbols is not the point; what matters is that the probabilities are close to equal.
fix: "A source whose symbols have nearly equal probabilities has high entropy; a source that almost always sends the same symbol has low entropy."

problem: Base-2 logarithms are written "log2" in running text (e.g. "Hmax = log2 M", "log2 8 = 3") but as log<sub>2</sub> inside the displayed formulas, so the notation is inconsistent.
fix: Use log<sub>2</sub> (or log₂) everywhere, including in prose, traps and quiz answers.
